column1: # One thing, or two words? Each pair is said inside a primer sentence that leaves the voice no
# choice: the compound at the end of a sentence about the thing (beat first), the describing
# word after a second adjective (beat on the noun). pick_takes.py cuts out the third column.
# Columns: clip id, what the voice says, the words to keep.

column2: The teacher wrote on the blackboard.
I found an old, black board.
The tomatoes grow in the greenhouse.
They live in a small, green house.
For lunch, I had a hotdog.
He lay in the sun all day. He was a tired, hot dog.
